answer.book: A single academic disputation of theses printed in Zurich in 1597 (Typis Wolphianis), built as a title page, a dedicatory address to Grynaeus and Polanus, and then one continuous run of numbered theses that ends at FINIS.

entries.title: Dn. D. Io. Iac. Grynaeo socero, Dn. D. Amando Polano a Polansdorf genero, duobus orbis luminaribus, pastoribus et theologis Basil. Hasce obedientiae activae et passivae Dn. N.
